title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: core/types.hpp and physics/perfect_gas.cpp implement 2D conservative perfect-gas equations; report.tex describes nondimensional equations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp supports TRI/QUAD/MIXED and multiple zones with interface welding; production Re200 log reports both zones and 10185 merged cells. No 3D support.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: numerics/residual.cpp constructs interior and boundary FV fluxes, with positivity fallback. Eight bounded verification checks passed including first- and second-order conservation; these do not prove full-run convergence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics/riemann.cpp:94–166 implements Roe/Harten-Yee with Rusanov fallback; HLLC and Rusanov alternatives exist. Re200 exact old binary remains unbound.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: numerics/boundary_conditions.cpp and residual.cpp:264–311 implement farfield, slip and adiabatic no-slip wall paths; wall output semantics use boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: residual.cpp:115–190 reconstructs limited face states; seven steady metadata entries revision b350651 report active second order with documented fallback. Re200 full-run fallback count was not measured on older binary.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat and positivity guard exist in source. Steady M2 selected metadata reports 595 fallback events on 324 steps; contestant docs/binary_provenance.md:117–120 says 326, a stale/inconsistent count. Re200 production fallback counts were not measured; a separate one-rank first-100-step probe cannot establish the remaining trajectory.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics/viscous.cpp implements stress/heat transport and solver/forces.cpp:122–131 projects wall traction tangentially; reported pressure/viscous split is not a full normal traction mislabel.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver/implicit_lusgs.cpp contains implicit spectral-radius LU-SGS sweeps; steady stopping checks residual and Cd window. Selected M015 laminar lift drift qualifies the Cd-only check.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Final transient source assembles total BDF residual and measures inner ratio (transient_driver.cpp:185–209,246–264,288–294); selected Re200 metadata claims 0/30000 misses, log provides sampled ratios and t300. Exact older production binary is not independently bound; no unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: main.cpp:285–325 root preprocesses/partitions and destroys global mesh; halo_exchange.cpp:59–70 performs neighbor nonblocking exchanges. Submitted np1/np8 comparisons lack order-one absolute force mismatch.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
